tagline: Arrive out of nowhere for +2, then vanish before the answer lands

featuredCards.title: The Bat-signal
featuredCards.caption: Two cards now, and while it sticks he repositions before every turn — as long as he keeps winning combats.

featuredCards.title: Smoke Pellet
featuredCards.caption: Cancels the clever half of your card and puts him outside your zone, which re-arms the ambush bonus.

featuredCards.title: The Dark Knight
featuredCards.caption: A printed 1 that lands as a critical strike. Coming in from out of the zone is what makes it lethal.

featuredCards.title: Coordinated Assault
featuredCards.caption: Him on one side, two tons of Batmobile on the other. Flanked, it jumps to five.
